minutes.headline: Planning Board moved to accept the Settler's Solar stormwater permit, with an applicant-funded construction monitor
minutes.summary: The board went through the final edits to the stormwater special permit for the Northfield Road solar project. The edits added an extended erosion barrier and named a construction monitor paid by the applicant. A motion to accept the permit was made. The board also moved on prior minutes and on an open space ad hoc committee appointment, and talked about the upcoming Town Meeting and the board vacancy.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board took up final edits to the Settler's Solar stormwater special permit and a motion to accept it was made; the outcome is not audible.
The permit is to name a construction monitor for the Northfield Road solar project, paid by the applicant rather than the town.
A motion to appoint an at-large member to the open space ad hoc committee was made; the outcome is not audible in the recording.
The board will leave the Green Communities liaison open until it reorganizes, and wants to use free GIS hours that expire at year end.
A resident asked for a formal process to fill the board vacancy and described the Town Meeting marijuana moratorium vote as a vote for time.

why_it_matters: The stormwater permit sets erosion and monitoring conditions for a solar project, and having the applicant pay for the monitor keeps that cost off the town budget, mostly taxes.
Residents will be asked at Town Meeting to vote on the marijuana moratorium, and the board vacancy affects who reviews future projects.
watch_next: Town Meeting vote on the marijuana moratorium, discussed at this meeting.
Whether the board fills its vacancy and uses the free GIS hours before the calendar year ends.
